items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1961-10-13
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I got Steve Albert out, huh? [INTERVIEWEE] Steve didn't play.

ctx.x: Let me see now. Let me get that line up together.
I got Steve Albert out, huh?
Steve didn't play. Herbert Richardson. Yeah, I see. Herbert Richardson. Was, did O.L. play with us? Earl Fochette? I don't know.
